verdict.what: a multi-tier Japanese-style pagoda or tower, built as a tiered wooden temple
verdict.style: East Asian pagoda / temple, dark oak with stone plinth
verdict.looks: A three-tier wooden pagoda on a grey stone-brick plinth. The base is a wide dark-oak box with rows of framed recessed panels and a few lit lanterns at the entrance. Above it, a second hipped roof with stepped dark-stone eaves and upturned corner finials, then a narrower third tier with its own cornice and finials, and a tall central spire with dark stick-like tips. Materials are dark oak planks, spruce/stripped log trim, cobblestone-type grey stone roof edges, and light stone bases. The colour is mostly warm brown with grey accents. The side view shows the upper tiers offset and staggered, and the back view shows a column-and-beam open lantern tier that reads as a lighter frame.
verdict.summary: A well-proportioned three-tier wooden pagoda with a convincing stepped silhouette and nice finials, held back only by slightly busy, mixed-block roof edges and a spire that needs tidying before you'd call it done.
